title: Stranger Things: When Objects Appear Without Their Typical Neighbors
abstract: arXiv:2611.34881v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual context is a powerful cue for object recognition: scenes inform what, where, and at what scale objects are likely to appear. Yet over-reliance on context becomes a failure mode when models predict objects based on their typical neighbors rather than the objects' own visual features, which we call typicality bias. While extensively studied in the pre-Transformer era, it has often been assumed that architectural and scale improvements would naturally solve it, and a systematic diagnostic across the modern vision stack remains absent. We provide such a diagnostic framework. We measure typicality bias via normalized pointwise mutual information (NPMI) over object pairs, and introduce STRANGE-Bench (Synthetic Typicality-RANked Grounded Evaluation Benchmark): a photorealistic, layout-controlled benchmark spanning 17 sub-tiers from typical to never-co-occurring object pairs. translated_title: 怪异之物：当物体脱离其典型邻居出现时
translated_abstract: 视觉上下文是物体识别的一个强大线索：场景能够提示物体可能以何种内容、在何处、以何种尺度出现。然而，当模型依据物体的典型邻居而非物体自身的视觉特征来预测物体时，对上下文的过度依赖便成为一种失败模式，我们将其称为典型性偏差（typicality bias）。尽管这一问题在Transformer出现之前的时代已被广泛研究，但人们通常假设架构与规模的改进会自然地解决它，而针对现代视觉技术栈的系统性诊断仍然缺失。我们提供了这样一个诊断框架。我们通过物体对上的归一化逐点互信息（NPMI）来度量典型性偏差，并引入STRANGE-Bench（合成典型性排序接地评估基准）：一个照片级真实感、布局受控的基准，涵盖从典型共现到从不共现的物体对的17个子层级。在五个模型家族（专用检测器、开放词表……
tldr: 该论文提出了通过归一化逐点互信息（NPMI）度量典型性偏差的诊断框架，并构建了照片级真实感、布局受控的STRANGE-Bench基准（涵盖17个从典型到从不共现的物体对子层级），首次系统性地诊断了现代视觉模型中因依赖上下文邻居而忽视物体自身特征的典型性偏差问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a diagnostic framework that measures typicality bias via normalized pointwise mutual information (NPMI) and presents STRANGE-Bench, a photorealistic, layout-controlled benchmark spanning 17 sub-tiers, to systematically diagnose context-overreliance across the modern vision stack.
